criteria.text: Exactly 20 Luna generation calls and zero scoring calls are made on the frozen seed-20260810 twenty, with the root orchestrator reading blind and no paid second reader.

Coverage, language and evaluation are complete at 20/20, the current weighted and raw scores are reported with their intervals, and the score is cut by attainable ceiling rather than quoted as one aggregate.
Every paired delta is attributed to a named cause or refused, and any claim the first-turn set cannot support is refused in the report rather than hedged.
